text:
After sharing efforts of Punjab AAP gov since 2022 for assisting in cutting stubble of than burning, 

Now let me share how & where this collected stubble is going & how stubble is turning into wealth !!

New 1400 Crore Bio-ethanol HPCL plant was brought in 2023 in Punjab through Punjab Gov PEDA as Nodal Agency.

HPCL started collecting/buying stubble/paddy straw in 2023 & has so far aggregated around 1.25 lakh tonnes of stubble/paddy straw over the previous two kharif seasons.

HPCL plant will now start production in March-2027 thus regularly  processing stubble in future & this giving permanent resolution to stubble burning.

Abhijit Kaplish, chief executive of the Punjab Energy Development Agency (PEDA), said the project was intended to demonstrate how agricultural residue could be converted into a useful industrial resource. He highlighted its potential to create a supply chain for farm waste, reduce stubble burning and seasonal air pollution, and lower greenhouse gas emissions and dependence on imported crude oil.

Designed initially as a pilot initiative for paddy-stubble management, the Bathinda facility could also offer a model for other states seeking to utilise agricultural residue on a larger scale.
